scoring_justification: Cannot recompute RCWA simulation in verifier; verify structural properties (monotonic wavelength decrease, non-subwavelength condition) and closeness to reference wavelengths with tolerances.

outputs.description: TM-polarized GMR filter resonance characteristics for the seven specified incidence angles.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the reported peak_wavelength_nm to hidden gold values derived from the paper's experimental measurements, and verifies the non-subwavelength condition: for angles ≥35°, peak_wavelength_nm must be less than the grating period (574 nm).

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference peak wavelengths, reflectances, and FWHMs for the seven incidence angles derived from the paper's experimental measurements (Table 1 and text).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Table 1 for 25°,35°,45°; text for 20° and 50°; 30° and 40° interpolated.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's experimental data: 20°→670.32 nm (text), 25°→627.41 nm (Table 1), 30°≈600 nm (interpolated), 35°→550.03 nm (Table 1), 40°≈515 nm (interpolated), 45°→480.64 nm (Table 1), 50°→463.21 nm (text). Reflectances and FWHMs from Table 1 and text where available, estimated otherwise.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual experimentally measured values reported in the paper; used as reference for reproduction scoring.
